title: 蜂巢式基地台整合
summary: 以基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 系統功能圖：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: System functional map: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「系統功能圖」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For system functional map, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「系統功能圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「功能切分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around system functional map, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat functional splits as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 比較「系統功能圖」與「功能切分」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Compare whether evidence for system functional map and functional splits supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 天線數直接等於任何位置的可用 MIMO 層數。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Antenna count equals usable MIMO layers at every location. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「系統功能圖」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for system functional map. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。
knowledge.textEn: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「功能切分」：切分位置改變傳輸容量與時間限制。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「系統功能圖」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring functional splits: Split placement changes transport-capacity and timing constraints. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove system functional map passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

knowledge.textEn: Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 20 MHz 教學頻寬與 4 bit/s/Hz 有效效率，單層吞吐 80 Mbit/s；假定四層可獨立利用為 320 Mbit/s，此為理想上界，未計協議開銷與實際通道秩。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical 20 MHz channel at 4 bit/s/Hz yields 80 Mbit/s per layer; four independent layers imply 320 Mbit/s as an ideal upper bound, excluding overhead and actual channel rank.
